definition: Evaluation agreements are contracts in which one party agrees to assess or test another party’s product, service, or technology. These agreements typically serve as a preliminary step toward a potential investment, license, or purchase, contingent on satisfactory results. They are also known as product evaluation, pilot, or trial agreements. Evaluation agreements are common in industries such as software, biotechnology, and pharmaceuticals.
